rules: Never fan out every source at the same interval.
Prefer official sources; use provider fallback only when official coverage is missing or unhealthy.
Respect Retry-After and rate-limit headers when upstreams provide them.
Retain last-good league data when a source fails or returns an implausibly empty result.
Keep live/today refreshes isolated from long-range calendar work.
Expose per-source health, last success, event count, and stale age in diagnostics.
